name: Subzero Salvo

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Alloy Casing
perks.desc:
Reduces weight for faster reloads.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Black Powder
perks.desc:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Impact Casing
perks.desc:
Increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.desc:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine. 

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.desc: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.desc: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.desc: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.desc: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.desc: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Winterized Gear
perks.desc: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, this weapon gains stability, reload speed, and handling. These benefits decay over time after reentering combat.

notes: [YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Velocity/Handling] "Are there better options in-slot? Sure. But how crazy does this look design-wise? You get decent access to Ambitious Assassin for general use, Chain Reaction is great, Demolitionist is good utility, and Clusters never hurt to have." tags:pve
